## CRISPR off-target prediction with probabilistic sequence models

Development and validation of computational methods for CRISPR–Cas9 off-target analysis, with emphasis on probabilistic sequence alignment, genome-wide candidate analysis, and uncertainty modelling.

::: {.project-columns}
::: {.project-subpanel}
### My contribution
- PHMM-based guide–target modelling
- reproducible Python pipelines
- genome-scale analyses and benchmarking
- experimental off-target datasets
- uncertainty-aware alignment features
:::
